read.thesis: Record 7.2Mt shipments and EBITDA ~$2.28B with capex moderating to ~$2.5B and FCF $1.6B in Q3; Q4 guided flat-to-modestly-up earnings despite seasonal volume drop and West Virginia startup costs.

utilisation.quote: Steel mill utilization -- 89%, compared to 91% in the second quarter of 2026.

capex.quote: For the full year, we expect our capital expenditures to finish at or slightly below our original $2.5 billion estimate.

triggers.label: Capex moderating; 2027 lower again
triggers.quote: Looking ahead, we expect our CapEx to decline further in 2027, extending the step down from peak spending in 2024 and 2025.

triggers.label: Downstream pricing catching up to inputs
triggers.quote: realized pricing in our downstream businesses is catching up with the higher steel input costs that compressed margins earlier this year

triggers.label: Import surge from South Korea
triggers.quote: import volumes have been increasing in recent months, including a massive surge from South Korea, despite the Section 232 tariffs

triggers.label: Mill utilisation 91% → 89%
triggers.quote: Steel mill utilization -- 89%, compared to 91% in the second quarter of 2026.

triggers.label: Q4 earnings flat to modestly up
triggers.quote: we expect consolidated earnings to be in line with or modestly higher than the third quarter results

guidance.value: in line with or modestly higher than Q3
guidance.quote: we expect consolidated earnings to be in line with or modestly higher than the third quarter results
Nucor continues to expect steel mill shipments growth to finish closer to the higher end of our 5%-10% range for 2026
we expect our capital expenditures to finish at or slightly below our original $2.5 billion estimate
we now expect our long-term annual EBITDA contribution from our towers and structures business to reach approximately $200 million, up from the $150 million previously forecast
West Virginia sheet mill utilization target -- 50% by the end of 2027

guidance.value: at least 40% of net earnings annually
guidance.quote: We remain committed to returning at least 40% of net earnings to shareholders on an annual basis.

red_flags.label: Import surge despite Section 232 tariffs
red_flags.quote: import volumes have been increasing in recent months, including a massive surge from South Korea, despite the Section 232 tariffs

red_flags.label: Conversion cost creep and Q4 startup costs
red_flags.quote: The cost increase reflects lower fixed cost absorption and higher start-up spending at West Virginia
